home.footer: Webhusaiti yashandurwa uye yava kuwanikwa mumitauro 100+!
home.descriptionA: Mukuru akazara-stack injiniya ane 6+ makore echiitiko achitora zvigadzirwa kubva kune zvisinganzwisisike zvinodiwa kune akavimbika ekugadzira masisitimu. I nzira dzekuendesa zvikwata zvinogona kushanda nechivimbo.
home.descriptionB: Basa rangu rinobatanidza sarudzo dzeinjiniya kune zvabuda mubhizinesi. Kubva kune yekuvaka-yekufungidzira SaaS inoshandura dheti dhata kuita mutengi-akagadzirira mazano kune anogadzira mari ewebhu mapuratifomu, ini ndinovaka software yakatenderedza mafambiro ebasa, njodzi, uye. kukosha kunoyerwa kunokosha kuvanhu vanoishandisa.

featured.title: Mabasa akasarudzwa
featured.description: Mapurojekiti matanhatu anomiririra zvakanyanya kuti ndinoshandura sei pfungwa dzine nzira dzakasimba kuita software yakanaka uye inoshanda.

atlas.title: Atlas yeinjiniya
atlas.footer: Nzvimbo dzakasiyana. Tsika imwe chete yeinjiniya yakabatana.

takeoff_engine.summary: Masperedishiti asina kuenderana anopinda. Zviyero zvekuvaka uye zvikumbiro zvakagadzirirwa mutengi zvinobuda. Chigadzirwa cheSaaS chakavakwa kutenderedza nzira yechokwadi yebasa remukontrakita.
takeoff_engine.lens: Kupinda kwakasununguka kunoda modhi yakasimba yemukati: kutambira mafomati akawanda hakufaniri kusimbisa mitemo yekuverenga iyo bid rinotsamira pairi.

inventory_register.summary: Nzira yebasa yepoindi yekutengesa neAngular neNode.js inobatanidza vashandisi vakasimbiswa, kururama kweinventory, uye nzira yekubhadhara yakaedzwa.
inventory_register.lens: Regista yemari inopfuura skrini yekubhadhara. Mabasa, shanduko yezvinhu, uye mamiriro ekubhadhara zvinoda miganhu yakajeka kuti nzira yebasa irambe ichizvidavirira.

grocery_app.summary: Application ye.NET 9 Blazor ine miganhu yemutongi, sevhisi, uye repository, kugadzikana kweEntity Framework Core, uye seti izere yekuyedza.
grocery_app.lens: Kupatsanurwa kunowana nzvimbo yayo kana mitemo yebhizinesi ichigona kuyedzwa zvisina kubatana ne interface uye huwandu hwekugadzikana.

payrollobol.summary: Kugadzirisa mihoro kweGnuCOBOL kunosangana nebhuku guru reSQLite rinopinda kaviri uye dashboard yekushanda yeSvelte.
payrollobol.lens: Kururama kwemari kunotanga nehumiriri: masvomhu esenti dzakazara uye zvinyorwa zvakagadziriswa zvinoita kuti kufamba kwemari kuve kwakajeka.

interop.summary: Referensi yemitauro yakasiyana inosanganisira mitauro {languages} yerongwa uye mapatani {patterns} ekushanda, ichiongorora zvinoitika kumiganhu yenguva yekushanda.
interop.lens: Chikamu chakaoma chibvumirano pakati penguva dzekushanda: kuchinjana data, maitiro ehurongwa, uye kudzokororwa kwekushanda kwakakosha kupfuura syntax.

formatter.summary: Injini yechokwadi yekuongorora Go yakanyorwa kuWebAssembly. Kusimbisa uye kugadzira JSON neYAML kunoshanda munharaunda yebrowser.
formatter.lens: Kuendesa parser ku browser kunochinjanisa mutoro mukuru wevatsigiri kuti ugadzirise munzvimbo, kubva kune imwe nzvimbo, uye kutsamira kushoma kweserver.

portfolio_website.summary: Saiti yauri mairi: portfolio yeReact ine mitauro 100+, kudyidzana kunowanikwa, uye zvishandiso zveWebAssembly zvinoshanda.
portfolio_website.lens: Kuiswa kwakamira hakureve chiitiko chakamira. Kudyidzana kwakapfuma kunogona kugara kune muvatsigiri pasina server reapplication.

biblioteca.summary: Pipe yekunatsa mutauro yePython inoshandura sosi imwe yemukati wakarongeka kuita portfolio inowanikwa mumitauro 100+.
biblioteca.lens: Kusvika kwepasi rose idambudziko rekuchengeta data pamwe nedambudziko rekuturikira. Sosi imwe yechokwadi inoita kuti shanduko yemukati igone kubata.

personal_summary.title: Pfupiso Yega
personal_summary.text: Ini ndiri mukuru akazara-stack injiniya anogara muOrlando, FL ane nzira kubva kune dambudziko rechigadzirwa kuenda kumhedzisiro yekugadzira. Ndinoita sarudzo dzetekinoroji musevhisi yehurongwa: .NET uye Entity Framework Core kana yakanyatso kurongeka domain uye testable persistence matter; Angular kana React kana yakaoma workflows inoda inogadziriswa interface; Node.js kana Go kana API, kusanganisa, kana chepamusoro-chishandiso chishandiso chinoda yakanangana nekumhanya nguva. Pakati pezvigadzirwa zveSaaS, mafambiro emukati, uye mapuratifomu anotarisana nevatengi, ini ndinotungamira nekutengesa kwakajeka, dhizaini yakachengeteka uye yakasimba, kuyedza otomatiki, uye maitiro ekutumira ayo batsira zvikwata kutumira software yakakosha pasina kusiya chikwereti chekushanda kumashure.

technical_skills.title: Unyanzvi hwokugadzira
technical_skills.no_samples: Chikamu chezvishandiso zvangu zvekushanda. Ndiri kufara kutsanangura kuti ndakashandisa sei.

entries.title: Yakazara Stack Injiniya
entries.text: Ini ndinotungamira kuguma-kusvika-kumagumo chigadzirwa kuendesa: kushandura bhizinesi workflows musystem miganhu, data modhi, APIs, uye interfaces, zvino kutakura basa kuburikidza nekuyedza, kutumira, uye iteration. Chinangwa isoftware iyo timu inogona kushanduka nekushanda, kwete muunganidzwa wemasikirini akabviswa.

entries.title: Chigadzirwa & Platform Architecture
entries.text: Ndinosarudza mapuratifomu uye mapatani zvichienderana nedambudziko: layered .NET masevhisi enzvimbo dzebhizinesi, chikamu chinofambiswa neAngular kana React zvikumbiro zvekushanda kwakaoma, hukama data modhi yekuzvidavirira workflows, uye kubatanidzwa kwakagadzirwa nemamodhi ekukundikana, kutonga kwekuwana, uye kuchengetedza mupfungwa.

entries.title: Kugadzirwa-Kugadzirira Kuendesa
entries.text: Ini ndinovaka nezvinoitika mushure mekutangwa muchitarisiko: zvakavanzika zvakachengetwa kunze kwekutonga kwechitubu, nzira dzakajeka dzekufambisa dhatabhesi, mvumo-yakavakirwa basa, kusimbiswa pamiganhu yehurongwa, otomatiki bvunzo, CI/CD kuziva, uye inoshanda kucherechedzwa. Aya ndiwo mashoko anoshandura prototype kuita software yakavimbika.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: Python-based localization pombi inoshandura imwe yakarongwa yemukati sosi kuita portfolio inowanikwa pasi rose. Inobata dhata reshanduro segadziriro inochengeteka kwete kuita kopi yepeji nemaoko, ichibvumira saiti kuti isvike mumitauro 100+ uye kuita kuti pasi rose risvike kugona kushanda pachinzvimbo chenguva imwe chete.

connect_four.title: Batanidza Four
connect_four.text: Mhuri huru ye{implementations} mashandisiro emutambo weMina mutsara. Purojekiti iyi inosanganisira mitauro {languages} yerongwa, kusanganisira Java, C++, Python, neJavaScript, pamwe ne{frameworks} maframework, maibhurari, nguva dzekushanda, uye dhatabhesi akasiyana, kubva kuReact, Angular, neBlazor kuenda kuDjango, Spring Boot, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, nezvimwe.

grocery_app.title: Grocery App
grocery_app.text: A full-stack .NET 9 Blazor Server application inoratidza nemaune backend architecture yebhizimusi workflow. Iyo controller / sevhisi / repository kupatsanurwa inochengeta mitemo yekushandisa, kuwana data, uye mharidzo yakazvimirira inoyedzwa; Entity Framework Core inopa kushingirira kwakasimba; uye comprehensive test suite inochengetedza maitiro sezvo chigadzirwa chinoshanduka.

interop.title: Interop Project
interop.text: Mutauro-mutauro wekudyidzana wereferensi inotora mitauro {languages} yekuronga uye {patterns} maitiro ekuita. Iyo purojekiti inoongorora muganho umo masisitimu anowanzoita asina kusimba: kuita zvibvumirano, kuchinjanisa data, maitiro ekumhanya, uye nzira dzinodzokororwa dzekubatanidza. Inoratidza masisitimu ekufunga anodiwa kana chigadzirwa chakakura pane imwe stack.

inventory_register.title: Inventory Register
inventory_register.text: Iyo yakazara-stack POS uye hesitori workflow yakavakwa neAngular 17+ uye Node.js. Iyo inoenzanisira zvinonetsa zvekushanda kweB2B system: vashandisi vakatendeseka, basa-rinoenderana nekuwana kudzora, kurongeka kweiyo, uye kuyerera kwekubhadhara kwekunyomba. Iyo purojekiti yakagadzirirwa kutenderedza basa chairo rinoitwa neboka rerejista, kwete chete katalog yemaitiro ehurongwa.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL
payrollobol.text: Hurongwa hwepano hwekugadzirisa mihoro hwakavakwa neGnuCOBOL, bhuku guru reSQLite rinopinda kaviri, uye dashboard yekushanda yeSvelte. Inoshandisa masvomhu esenti dzakazara, kugadzirisa mihoro yebatch, uye dashboard yeloopback kuita kuti nzira dzemari dzive dzakajeka, kuyedzwa, uye rubatsiro rwekushanda.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Auto Formatter
formatter.text: Bhurawuza-yakavakirwa JSON uye YAML kusimbiswa uye fomati chishandiso chakavakirwa muGo uye chakagadzirirwa kuWebAssembly. Kufambisa injini yekufambisa muWASM inochengeta kupindirana kuchipindura uye kwenzvimbo kune bhurawuza paunenge uchishandisa parser chaiyo kuti ubate iyo isiriyo yekuisa. Iwo muenzaniso wakatarisana wekusarudza yekumhanyisa nguva yekuvaka yekuita, kutakurika, uye mushandisi kuvimba.

takeoff_engine.title: Takeoff Injini
takeoff_engine.text: Yekuvaka inofungidzira SaaS yakavakirwa yakatenderedza inodhura, ine kukanganisa-inokonzeresa kontrakiti mafambiro. Iyo React + Express chigadzirwa inomedza CSV neExcel data, mepu isingaenderane makoramu mune inoshandisika domain modhi, inoverengera kuchera mugero uye mavhoriyamu evhu, inoteedzera basa uye. markup, uye inogadzira mutengi-akagadzirira PDF uye Shoko mazano. Iyi izere chigadzirwa lifecycle engineering: data parsing, mitemo yekuverenga, yakakwenenzverwa opareta mafambiro, uye zvinounzwa zvinobatsira bhizinesi kufamba kubva pambiru yekuisa kuenda kubhidhi.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON jenareta
minecraft_json_generator.text: Yakareruka JSON jenareta yakavakirwa muPython yeMinecraft sosi & data packs. Iyi purojekiti inoshandiswa kugadzira mafaira eJSON eMinecraft mods, kusanganisira zvinhu zvetsika, zvidhinha, uye masangano. Inobatsira kwazvo kwete chete kugadzira tsika dhatapa, asi kune mods zvakare kuburikidza neiyo mod zita rekuchinja chimiro.

educational_experience.title: Chiitiko Changu Chedzidzo
educational_experience.text: Padivi pezvirongwa zvangu pachangu, ini ndakawanawo hunyanzvi hwakawanda kubva muruzivo rwedzidzo. Dzvanya pano kuti uone yangu LinkedIn profile kuti uwane rumwe ruzivo.

professional_experience.title: Yangu Professional Experience
professional_experience.text: Makore matanhatu-pamwe ehunyanzvi hweinjiniya ruzivo pazvikwata zvechigadzirwa, mapuratifomu ebhizinesi, uye software yakatarisana nevatengi. Basa rangu raisanganisira kuvaka zvigadziriso zvekushandisa, kushandira pamwe panzira dzekuendesa, uye kuita sarudzo dzehunyanzvi nehupenyu hwechigadzirwa, kushanda. njodzi, uye hutori hwenguva refu mukuona.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin Portfolio Webhusaiti
portfolio_website.text: Iyo yekugadzira-yepfungwa React portfolio inobata kuwanikwa uye kusvika kwepasirese sezvinodiwa zveinjiniya. Zvinosanganisira pombi inochengeteka yekushandura yemitauro 100+, maturusi ekudyidzana anotsigirwa neWebAssembly, maUI anoteerera uye anosvikirika, uye mavakirwo epurojekiti. yakagadzirirwa kukura sezvo basa idzva rinotumirwa.

scripting_library.title: Scripting Library
scripting_library.text: A consolidated library of automation scripts, with one page per language: VBA for Excel spreadsheets, Lua for lightweight tooling, PowerShell for Windows administration, Python for everyday data work, and Ruby for scripting experiments. Each script is written to be reused, so the collection is maintained as one project instead of five scattered repositories.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Yangu yega Neovim kumisikidzwa. Iyi purojekiti inoshandiswa kugadzirisa Neovim kune zvandinoda, kusanganisira makiyi makiyi, madingindira, uye plugins. Iyi purojekiti inoshandiswa kuita kuti Neovim iwedzere mushandisi-ane hushamwari uye inoshanda pakushandisa kwangu pachangu.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Mepu jenareta
python_maps.text: A Python geospatial reporting tool yakavakwa neGeoPandas uye Matplotlib kugadzira US County nemamepu enyika. Inoshandura geographic data kuita inoverengeka yekuongorora zvigadzirwa, ichiratidza pombi yedata yepfungwa: sarudza iyo chaiyo domain raibhurari, gadzirisa zvinopinda, uye gadzira zvinobuda izvo. tsigira sarudzo dzakajeka.

pdf_builder.title: PDF Skills Builder
pdf_builder.text: Gwaro-chizvarwa chekufamba-famba chakavakwa nePython, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, uye yakarongeka JSON data. Iyo inoparadzanisa data rinogona kushandiswazve kubva kumharidzo matemplate kuti agadzire akaenderana ePDF anotangazve nguva dzose, maitiro anoshanda ekudzikisa basa remaoko uye kugadzira zvinyorwa zvebhizinesi. inodzokororwa.

rijndael_encryption.title: Rijndael Encryption Project
rijndael_encryption.text: Seti yekuenzanisa ye{implementations} Rijndael mashandisirwo mukati me128-, 192-, uye 256-bit akasiyana. Kudzokorodza kuchengetedzwa-sensitive algorithm mumitauro yese ibasa rakarongeka mune zvakatemwa, maitiro anoyedzwa, uye miganhu yekutakurika kwemutauro, ese anobatsira masikirwo emasisitimu anobata data rakadzama.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: Mod yeMinecraft inowedzera zvishandiso zvakasarudzika, nhumbi dzehondo, mobs, block, hukuru, uye zvimwe zvakawanda zvinhu kumutambo. Yakavakwa zvakanyanya neJava neKotlin, ichitsigira vhezheni dzeMinecraft 1.16 kusvika 26.2.

rubix_cube_solver.title: Rubik's Cube Solver
rubix_cube_solver.text: An interactive 3D Rubik's Cube you paint sticker by sticker - on the cube itself or on its unfolded net - and then solve with a Herbert Kociemba style two-phase search compiled from Rust to WebAssembly. The Svelte interface renders the cube with three.js, keeps the painted state, its validity checks, and the solver's facelet string in sync, and plays the solution back move by move on a timeline you can scrub, step through, and re-play.

snake.title: Mutambo wenyoka
snake.text: Injini yakatsetseka yeNyoka yakavakwa neRust neMacroquad, yakanyorwa kuWebAssembly, uye inogadzirwa kuburikidza neHTML5 Canvas. Inosanganisa tick dzemutambo dze0.12-second deterministic nekufamba kwakanaka kwakabatanidzwa, nhanho dzemutambo dzakajeka, kutonga kunopindura, kubata kurovera uye mamiriro ekukunda, uye seti yekuyedza yakanangana inovhara mitemo yepakati pemutambo.

rustcraft.title: Rustcraft
rustcraft.text: A Minecraft-style voxel game built in Rust with wgpu and compiled to WebAssembly, so it plays straight in the browser. It is the arcade's sandbox build: blocky terrain and a voxel world drawn through a modern graphics pipeline, written from scratch on the Rust toolchain rather than on top of a game engine.

tiger_programming_language.title: Tiger Programming Mutauro
tiger_programming_language.text: Mutauro wechirongwa chetsika uye muturikiri wakavakwa muGo kuti uongorore dhizaini yemutauro wenguva, maitiro ekuita, uye mashandiro anoita. Kuiunganidza kuWebAssembly uye kuibatanidza mupodfolio inogadzira chaiyo, inotarisika chigadzirwa chepamusoro chemasisitimu-level engineering pane kusiya basa se repository-chete kuedza.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tiger Tailgating Pros Webhusaiti
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Webhusaiti yeReact yakaunzwa yeClemson, SC inomisa bhizinesi. Iro basa rinoshandura kupa kwebhizinesi diki kuita rwendo rwakajeka rwevatengi uye kuvapo kwewebhu kwakavimbika, kushandisa kufunga kwechigadzirwa kubatsira sangano chairo kushandura kufarira. mukubvunza uye mari.

turing_machine.title: Turing Machine Project
turing_machine.text: Mhuri yeanopfuura {implementations} mashandisirwo eTuring Machine. Inoshandiswa kuratidza kukwana kuzere kwemitauro yakasiyana yekuronga yekutsvaga, kunyanya yeTiger Programming Mutauro.

alkalab.title: Alkalab
alkalab.text: Lab'rik yekemikari yehupfu-jecha yakavakwa muRust uye yakanyorwa kuWebAssembly. Penda jecha, mvura, lava, simbi, calcium carbide, kana chidimbu chesodium uye ona kuti fizikisi nekemistri zvinorwa sei: sodium inoputika mumvura, calcium carbide inoburitsa acetylene, lava inonyengerera jecha kuita girazi, uye density chete inopatsanura oiri, mercury, uye jecha. Injini inoshanda zvinhu 32 uye mitemo 40 yekupindura yakaziviswa papamusoro pebuffer yakatsetseka yemasero, ichigadzira pixels zvakananga kubva kumemory yemutsetse wewasm pasina makopi eframe imwe neimwe.

contact.title: Ndibate
contact.description: Ini ndinopindura kumibvunzo kubva kune email uye LinkedIn meseji. Iniwo ndichafona zvakare kana nhamba yangu yakapihwa kuburikidza nekutangazve kana neimwe nzira, kunyangwe ini ndichifarira kuchengeta nhamba yangu yefoni yakavanzika.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Linter
formatter.description: Bhurawuza-yakavakirwa data mhando chishandiso chinosimbisa uye mafomati JSON uye YAML uchishandisa Go injini yakaunganidzwa kuWebAssembly. Iyo dhizaini inoramba ichienda padyo nemushandisi nekukurumidza, yakavanzika mhinduro uku uchisimbisa chaiyo syntax mitemo pamuganho wedata. Iwo muenzaniso wakakwana wekugadzira inovimbika yekuvandudza yekufambisa kutenderedza kurongeka, kuita, uye kuvimba.

formatter.empty_input: Ndokumbira uise imwe JSON kana YAML kuti unyore.
formatter.fixed_yaml_spacing: ⚠ YAML yanga iine spacing/indentation isiriyo asi yakagadziridzwa otomatiki uye yakarongwa.

tiger.title: Tiger Mutauro
tiger.description: Tiger itsika yekuronga mutauro uye Go muturikiri akavakirwa kuti aongorore runtime zvivakwa, mutauro semantics, uye kuita tradeoffs. Kuunganidza muturikiri kuWebAssembly inoshandura kuti masisitimu anoshanda kuita inodyidzana, browser-yakavakirwa chigadzirwa: vashandisi vanogona kuita zvirongwa zvakananga nepo nguva yekumhanya ichiri kutakurika. uye yakaparadzaniswa kubva kune iyo host application.
